notes: Three repetitions per side on 16 held-out pairs (32 variants). Each of the 16 scenario and action-type strata contributes one pair. Harbor v0.26.0 and upstream ran the same OpenAI Agents SDK, first request and 30-turn limit. The actor was gpt-5-mini and the Responses judge was gpt-5.4. The provider returned the judge alias and did not expose a dated revision. Its response to the release's dated judge ID was HTTP 503 model_not_found. Both reported metrics use proportions and sample SEM. The three-run score ranges overlap from 0.25 to 0.3125. Task-repeat agreement was 86/96. The MSE of 32 variant means was 0.055556. All 192 submissions received a real grade. The separate offline Oracle controls are excluded. The official HF contribution links the full evidence in the contributor-hosted dataset because the shared repository exceeds the Hub file limit.
